en: Sepia-toned photograph of a gently sloping, cobblestoned street lined with large trees on both sides. On the left is a multi‑story classical building with rectangular windows and simple decorative panels; on the right is a high stone wall and a sidewalk. A few pedestrians walk along the pavement. In the distance, partly framed by the trees, a cylindrical water tower or similar structure rises above lower buildings. At the very top center of the card, the number "1034" is handwritten in red ink.
